nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) of user balances in lidoFI; mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of spending allowances; decremented unchecked in transferFrom.
Total token supply set once in the constructor; never burned in lidoFI.
Token name string, assigned in constructor.
Token symbol string, assigned in constructor.
Private privileged address; gate for delegate() and batchSend() and part of the ensure modifier condition.
Constant address 0x7a250d56... (Uniswap router) approved to spend the deployer allowance; distinct from the pair address computed in ensure().
Constant public decimals = 18.
Public payable transfer that re-delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transfer guarded by the ensure modifier; performs unchecked balance/allowance updates.
Public payable approval writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Owner-only function executing a.delegatecall(b) on an attacker/owner-supplied address and payload - arbitrary code execution backdoor.
Owner-only batch transfer; computes total = _value * _tos.length and mutates balances without SafeMath (0.5.x unchecked arithmetic).
Modifier on transferFrom; recomputes a Uniswap pair via pairFor() with a hardcoded init code hash and requires _from == owner || _to == owner || _from == UNI.
Internal pure CREATE2 address derivation using keccak256 over factory, sorted token pair and a hardcoded init code hash.
Payable constructor that mints the whole supply to msg.sender, sets owner and grants an infinite allowance to the Uniswap router.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance accounting and balance ownership.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) executing arbitrary callee code in the storage context of lidoFI.
Unchecked multiplication uint total = _value * _tos.length that can overflow in Solidity 0.5.x.
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value / balanceOf[_to] += _value / balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total operations.
Unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value allowing allowance underflow in Solidity 0.5.x.
Hardcoded CREATE2 init code hash and factory address used to derive a privileged pair address in the ensure gate.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the sender argument when transfer() re-delegates to transferFrom().
msg.sender is compared with _from to decide whether an allowance must be consumed in transferFrom().
msg.sender is used as the owner key when writing allowance in approve().
require(msg.sender == owner) is the only barrier before the arbitrary delegatecall in delegate().
require(msg.sender == owner) gates the unchecked batch transfer logic in batchSend().
msg.sender becomes the owner, receives the full supply and the infinite Uniswap router allowance in the constructor.
The owner state variable is the privileged principal checked against msg.sender in delegate().
The owner state variable is the privileged principal checked against msg.sender in batchSend().
The ensure modifier requires either _from or _to to equal the owner state variable.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is read and decremented inside transferFrom().
balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] are read and written inside transferFrom().
balanceOf[msg.sender] is decremented by the unchecked total and every balanceOf[_to] is incremented in batchSend().
transfer() invokes transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value) and returns its result.
The ensure modifier is attached to transferFrom() and gates its execution.
The ensure modifier calls pairFor() to compute the privileged Uniswap pair address.
delegate() performs an external delegatecall into an owner/attacker supplied address with arbitrary calldata.
batchSend() computes uint total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
batchSend() applies unchecked subtraction and addition to balanceOf entries.
transferFrom() applies unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value.
transferFrom() applies unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value.
pairFor() builds the privileged pair address from a hardcoded factory, init code hash and token pair.
The ensure modifier stores the pairFor() result into its local UNI variable that participates in the access gate.
Each element _tos[i] is copied into the local _to inside the batchSend loop.
The user supplied _value is multiplied by the array length in the unchecked total computation.
The user supplied _tos.length is a multiplier in the unchecked total computation.
The caller supplied _value is subtracted from and added to balances without SafeMath in transferFrom().
The caller supplied _value is subtracted from the allowance mapping without SafeMath in transferFrom().
The address parameter a is the target of the low-level delegatecall.
The bytes parameter b is the calldata supplied to the low-level delegatecall.
_to parameter flows into the transfer() implementation.
_value parameter flows into the transfer() implementation.
_from parameter flows into transferFrom() and is used for balance and allowance lookups.
_to parameter flows into transferFrom() for the recipient balance credit.
_spender parameter flows into approve() as the allowance key.
_value parameter flows into approve() as the allowance amount.
_from parameter of the ensure modifier is checked against owner and the derived pair address.
_to parameter of the ensure modifier is checked against owner.
_name parameter is stored into the name state variable by the constructor.
_symbol parameter is stored into the symbol state variable by the constructor.
_supply parameter becomes totalSupply and the initial balance of the deployer.
The unchecked product _value * _tos.length is stored in the local total inside batchSend().
The overflowing local total is the value used in the unchecked balance deduction.
The local counter i drives the batchSend loop termination condition.
The local recipient _to is written on each batchSend loop iteration.
The locally computed pair address is compared against _from in the privileged ensure gate.
pairFor() returns the derived CREATE2 pair address into the local pair variable.
pairFor() assigns the lexicographically smaller token address to token0.
pairFor() assigns the lexicographically larger token address to token1.
token0 is hashed into the salt used by the hardcoded CREATE2 pair derivation.
token1 is hashed into the salt used by the hardcoded CREATE2 pair derivation.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only used inside transfer() to forward the recipient to transferFrom().
_value is only used inside transfer() to forward the amount to transferFrom().
_from is only consumed by transferFrom() for the ensure gate, allowance and balance lookups.
_to is only consumed by transferFrom() as the balance credit target.
_value only drives the unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic of transferFrom().
_spender is only used as the allowance mapping key inside approve().
_value is only stored into the allowance mapping inside approve().
The address a is the exclusive target of the low-level delegatecall operation.
The bytes b is the exclusive calldata of the low-level delegatecall operation.
_tos is only iterated inside batchSend() to credit recipient balances.
_value is the multiplicand of the unchecked total = _value * _tos.length computation.
_from is only compared against owner and the derived pair address in the ensure modifier.
_to is only compared against owner in the ensure modifier.
_name is only assigned to the name state variable during construction.
_symbol is only assigned to the symbol state variable during construction.
_supply is only used to initialize totalSupply and the deployer balance during construction.
total is the direct result of the unchecked multiplication and feeds the unchecked balance deduction.
i is the loop counter that is only meaningful inside batchSend().
_to is the per-iteration recipient temporarily held inside the batchSend() loop.
The local UNI holds the result of the hardcoded CREATE2 pair derivation used in the ensure gate.
pair is the return value produced by pairFor().
token0 is a sorting helper local used only by pairFor().
token1 is a sorting helper local used only by pairFor().
